text:
Elena (support): :rotating_light: Customer (acme-corp) reporting massive 503s starting ~08:12 UTC, spiking from 0.3% to ~18%. They say requests to /v1/generate are timing out or returning gateway errors. Sample request-id: rq_4a7f9c.
Dylan (oncall): pulling alerts and traces now. seeing a simultaneous latency bump on edge-gateway and a spike in 502/503 from the hosted routing layer. attaching recent alert: https://dash.company/alerts/ALERT-9923 :eyes:
OpsBot: incident created: INC-2026-1728888001, severity P1. Pager notified.
Priya (eng-runtime): I deployed a small hotpatch canary at 08:05 to enable the new slice-affinity selector (flag: route_affinity_v2=true) for 10% of traffic. Could be related. I rolled the canary to 5 pods on the edge pool.
Morgan (cs): Customer on a paid enterprise plan, encountering failures on live traffic. They reported degraded UX (requests failing) and are asking for ETA.
Elena (support): Customer sent cURL that reproduces: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-3b","input":"hello"}'
```
Response shows 503 and header `x-request-id: rq_4a7f9c`
Dylan (oncall): digging logs for rq_4a7f9c: found gateway returned 502 with backend error code KVCACHE_MISS and then 503 when failing to fallback. Host logs show kvcache eviction churn right after canary roll.
Priya (eng-runtime): that matches my hypothesis. route_affinity_v2 changed how keys are pinned to backend shards; I missed a TTL mixing with the legacy prefetch window. If TTLs differ across shards we can get cache thrashing and backend timeouts under load.
Dylan (oncall): quick telemetry snippets: 
- edge-gateway 5xx rate: 0.3% @08:00 -> 17.8% @08:13
- avg latency (p95): 210ms -> 1.8s
- backend kvcache misses/sec: 120 -> 2100
Priya (eng-runtime): I propose immediate rollback of the canary flag to avoid further impact. Can we coordinate a controlled rollback to 0% for route_affinity_v2 and scale down canary pods?
Morgan (cs): Customer wants status and ETA. Please confirm rollback plan and ETA so I can update them.
Dylan (oncall): agreed. I'll run the rollback and monitor. Plan: flip feature flag to false, scale the canary replicaset to 0, and verify 5xx drop under 1% in 5 minutes. I'll post exact commands.
Dylan (oncall): running step 1: `POST /admin/flags/route_affinity_v2 false --env=prod --scope=canary`
Dylan (oncall): step 2: `kubectl -n edge rollout undo rs/edge-proxy-canary --to-revision=42`
Priya (eng-runtime): note: undo revision 42 contains the previous kernel selector and affinity mapping. Good. After rollback I'll patch the kvcache TTL mismatch in staging and run a soak.
OpsBot: config-change: route_affinity_v2 set to false by dylan at 08:20:54 UTC
Dylan (oncall): scaling canary down: `kubectl -n edge scale rs/edge-proxy-canary --replicas=0` -> OK
Dylan (oncall): monitoring: 5xx falling: 17.8% -> 3.4% (1m), p95 down to ~240ms.
Elena (support): replying to customer: "we identified a canary config change that impacted cache affinity and caused elevated 5xx rates. We've rolled back the canary and are monitoring — will update within 10m."
Morgan (cs): customer responded: "Thanks — please confirm when fully mitigated, we'll hold additional traffic until you say ok."
Priya (eng-runtime): creating a follow-up runbook item and a patch PR to add TTL alignment check and a canary gating test for KV cache churn. Also recommend adding a preflight low-traffic soak for affinity changes.
Dylan (oncall): incident status: mitigation in progress, rollback completed, currently P1 -> tracking for 60m for regression verification. Creating postmortem ticket INC-POST-1728888001.
Incident Bot: severity downgraded to P2 at 08:27:58 UTC (metrics stabilized but watching). :white_check_mark:
Elena (support): closing loop with customer now. Will attach logs and timeline.
Morgan (cs): please add a customer-facing summary and schedule a 1:1 if they want a debrief.
Priya (eng-runtime): next actions: (1) reproduce in staging with high parallelism and patched TTLs, (2) add unit test for affinity->ttl mismatch, (3) PR to extend canary ramp gating to watch kvcache_miss_rate.
Dylan (oncall): thumbs up. If anyone sees a regression re-open this thread or ping @pager. :thumbsup:
Elena (support): thanks everyone, great coordination. I'll create the customer summary and close the incident once metrics hold for 1h. :lock_with_ink_pen:
